editorial.title: The Secret Valley
editorial.lead: A mountain village where each stay is private, but the land is shared.
editorial.storyIntro: Several cabins, a stone house, and shared outdoor spaces. Private stays, shared land.
editorial.storyLong: The Valley is a small, walkable mountain village made up of several cabins, a stone house, and shared outdoor spaces. Each stay is private, but the land itself is shared, creating a quiet sense of togetherness without obligation. Days here are unstructured—guests hike, read, cook, sit by the fire, and do very little on purpose.

practical.title: Practical details
practical.sheetClosing: Remote does not mean unprepared. The Valley is designed to function reliably in all seasons.
practical.locationBody: Transfers and directions use the Chereshovo area listing below—the same pin and phone we publish for wayfinding and local listings, so what you see here matches your booking.

access.title: Year-round access and parking
access.content: The Valley is accessible year-round. Parking is available at the designated area, with a 1km walk to the village (assistance available).

amenities.title: Reliable heating and hot water
amenities.content: All units are equipped with modern heating systems and hot water. The infrastructure is designed to function reliably in all seasons.

water.title: Drinking water availability
water.content: Fresh drinking water is available on-site. Each accommodation has access to clean, filtered water for all your needs.

winter.title: Winter and snow conditions
winter.content: The Valley is fully prepared for winter conditions. Pathways are maintained, and all systems are designed to handle snow and cold weather.

support.title: Support availability
support.content: Support is available in case of weather changes or emergencies. Remote does not mean unprepared—we ensure everything works reliably.
